wholePhysicalScope: The parish history gives the nominal length, width, north entrance and twin towers. Modern mapped approach and the hilltop tie locate the historical envelope approximately at the same site.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the domed bell towers, entry, stair, nave and aisle covers.
limitations: The model depicts the demolished 1902 cathedral in the early Allys period. Its 1963 replacement has a different structure.
The exact historical foundation position, covered aisle spacing, external color, stair grade, roof transitions and apse are estimated.
